seo.title: Homeless help in Houston - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified help in Houston for people experiencing homelessness: shelter, meals, showers, health care, benefits, jobs, ID, legal help, youth, veterans, and pets.

notice.text: Beds, schedules, routes, costs, and eligibility can change.
Call before traveling when possible. No listing guarantees a bed, meal, treatment, benefit, money, or job the same day. Call 911 for immediate danger or a medical emergency.

content.text: If you are newly homeless, call 211 first. For housing programs, complete a Coordinated Entry assessment through a participating provider such as The Beacon, SEARCH, Healthcare for the Homeless, Star of Hope, or another Coalition partner. An assessment is not a promise of immediate housing. Tell the worker where you are, whether you are safe tonight, medical needs, age, children, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, pets, and whether you have identification.
immediate violence, serious injury, trouble breathing, unconsciousness, overdose, fire, or another life-threatening emergency. Give the exact location and describe the danger first.
